# Codesphere

Matsayi: Mayu 6, 2026. Mayar da hankali: kimanta asusun gwaji, fitar da ƙarin King, da gudanar da ayyukan kiran bidiyo da ƙarfi.

## Taswirar Abubuwan Ciki

- [Profile mai aiki](#operating-profile)
- [Zaɓuɓɓukan Faɗawa](#Zaɓuɓɓukan Faɗawa)
- [King Gabatarwar Ƙarfafawa](#sarkin-tsawo-rollout)
- [Autoscaling don Kiran Bidiyo](#autoscaling-for-video-calls)
- [Sa idanu tare da OpenTelemetry](# sa ido-with-opentelemetry)
- [Imel da DNS](#email-and-dns)
- [Mataki na yanke shawara](# yanke shawara-maki)
- [Madogararsa](#sources)

## Profile mai aiki

Codesphere yana da amfani lokacin da muke son samfoti da za a iya sake sakewa da gwajin muhalli cikin sauri ba tare da yin aiki da Kubernetes da kanmu ba. Don samarwa, yanayin filin aiki dole ne ya kasance ** A kunne koyaushe ***. Jiran aiki bai dace da manufar haɗin kira ba saboda filin aiki na iya farawa da sauri, amma app ɗin har yanzu dole ne ya dawo da tsabta ta matakin gudu.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  User[Browser / Mobile] --> Domain[app.kingrt.com]
  Domain --> Frontend[Codesphere Frontend Service]
  Frontend --> Api[API Service]
  Frontend --> Ws[WebSocket Service]
  Ws --> Sfu[SFU / Call Runtime]
  Api --> Store[(DB / Object Store)]
  Sfu --> Store
  Api --> OTel[OTel Collector]
  Ws --> OTel
  Sfu --> OTel
```

## Zaɓuɓɓukan faɗaɗawa

| Zabin | Amfani da harka | Yiwuwar daidaitawa ta atomatik | Hadarin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wurin Aiki Guda Koyaushe-Aiki | Gwajin lissafi, demo, ƙaramin misali | A tsaye ta hanyar tsarin albarkatun; ma'auni a kwance yana da amfani kawai | Lokacin gudu ɗaya, babu ainihin SFU rarraba |
| Kwafi | Marasa Jiha HTTP/ API sabis | Ana iya ƙara kwafi a kwance ta hanyar UI/API | Raba tsarin fayil, babu gasa ya rubuta |
| shimfidar wuri | Ayyuka da yawa a cikin filin aiki ɗaya: gaba, API, WS, SFU, ma'aikaci | Za a iya girman ayyuka daban | Dole ne sadarwar sabis ta yi amfani da sunayen sabis na ciki |
| Jama'a API + King Orchestrator | Saki ta atomatik da ayyukan sikelin | Gidauniyar don King- sarrafa sikelin-fita | Tabbatar da ainihin abubuwan API a cikin asusun gwaji |
| Sabis na Jiha na Waje | DB, kantin kayan, jerin gwano, wasiku | Ƙirƙirar kwafi daga tsarin fayil ɗin sararin aiki | Kiyaye hanyar sadarwa, sirri, da madogara |

## King Fitowar Ƙarfafawa

1. Haɗa ma'ajin zuwa wurin aiki na Codesphere.
2. Saita wurin aiki zuwa ** Kullum A kunne *** idan yanayin ya kamata ya karɓi zirga-zirgar kira.
3. Kula da env vars a kowane wurin aiki: `KING_ENV`, `KING_BASE_URL`, `KING_API_URL`, `KING_WS_URL`, `KING_SFU_URL`, `KING_OBJECT_STORE_*`, `SMTP_*`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`.
4. Kula da `ci.yml` tare da shirye-shirye, gwaji, da gudanar da matakai. Dole ne matakin gudu ya fara kowane sabis ba tare da wata shakka ba kuma zai sake farawa ta atomatik bayan faɗuwa.
5. Rarraba shimfidar wuri: ayyana gaban gaba, API, WebSocket, SFU, da ma'aikacin baya a matsayin sabis na daban.
6. Yi amfani da sunayen sabis na Codesphere don sadarwar ciki, ba URLs na jama'a ba.
7. Kada a taɓa rubuta rajistan ayyukan zuwa fayil ɗin da aka raba. Idan rajistan ayyukan fayil ya zama dole, raba su kowane kwafi tare da `CS_REPLICA`.

```yaml
prepare:
  steps:
    - name: install frontend
      command: cd demo/video-chat/frontend-vue && npm ci && npm run build
    - name: backend sanity
      command: ./demo/video-chat/backend-king-php/tests/smoke.sh
test:
  steps:
    - name: frontend contracts
      command: cd demo/video-chat/frontend-vue && npm run test:contract:client-diagnostics
run:
  steps:
    - name: king api
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-api.sh
    - name: king ws
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-ws.sh
    - name: king sfu
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-sfu.sh
```

## Gyaran atomatik don Kiran Bidiyo

- **Haɗa manufa:** zauren kira da sigina dole ne ya zama dumi. Koyaushe-A kunne ya zama tilas ga manufa ta haɗin gwiwa na sub-na biyu.
- ** API na Jiha:** Kwafin lambobin ya dace idan an inganta zaman a tsakiya kuma ba a amfani da fayilolin gida azaman jiha.
- **WebSocket:** Ana buƙatar tuƙi mai ɗorewa ko wurin zama na tsakiya. Ba tare da shi ba, kwafin canje-canje suna rarraba yanayin kira ba daidai ba.
- **SFU:** Kar a kwaikwayi makaho. Dole ne a sanya ɗakuna zuwa SFU shard; King makada dole ne ya sarrafa daki-zuwa-SFU hanya da magudanar ruwa.
- **Kira aikace-aikacen / ma'aikata: *** ƙwararrun 'yan takara don kwafin kwance a kwance lokacin da ayyuka ke da ƙarfi da jerin gwano/kulle kai tsaye a wajen wurin aiki.
- **Tsarin fayil ɗin da aka raba:** Raba kwafin lambobin lambobin `/home/user/app`. Jihar Runtime, jitter buffers, uploads, da logs ba su cikin wurin.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser
  participant API as API Replica
  participant ORC as King Orchestrator
  participant SFU as SFU Shard
  participant O as Object Store
  B->>API: Join Call
  API->>ORC: allocate room / capabilities
  ORC->>SFU: reserve room
  SFU-->>ORC: room endpoint
  ORC-->>API: signed routing token
  API-->>B: ws/sfu endpoint
  B->>SFU: publish media
  SFU->>O: diagnostics / snapshots only
```

## Kulawa tare da OpenTelemetry

- Don Codesphere, aika OTLP kai tsaye zuwa mai karɓar waje da farko.
- Saitin ayyukan app `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, da `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`.
- Yi amfani da sunayen sabis daban kowane sabis: `king-api`, `king-ws`, `king-sfu`, `king-callapp-worker`.
- Da zarar shimfidar wurare sun tabbata, mai karɓar OTel zai iya gudana azaman sabis na ciki da fitarwa zuwa Grafana/Tempo/Loki/Prometheus Remote Write.

## Email da DNS

- Kar a gudanar da SMTP a gida. Wuraren aiki na lambobin ya kamata a aika ta hanyar SMTP na waje ko mai bada saƙon ma'amala.
- Ajiye sirrin a cikin env vars: `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASSWORD`, `MAIL_FROM`, `MAIL_REPLY_TO`.
- Rike DNS don rarrabuwar yanki na samarwa a cikin app/API/WS/SFU/CDN.
- Tabbatar da SPF, DKIM, da DMRC akan yankin aikawa ko yin rajista da imel ɗin jagora za su shiga cikin spam.

## Abubuwan yanke hukunci

- Shin asusun gwajin zai iya amfani da shimfidar wurare?
- Shin akwai damar API don kwafi/tsare-tsaren albarkatu don sarrafa atomatik?
- Ta yaya ake kunna yanki na al'ada da kuma sarrafa hanya a cikin asusun?
- Waɗanne iyakoki sun shafi CPU, RAM, ajiya, kwafi, da buɗe haɗin WebSocket?
- Za a iya SFU tashoshin jiragen ruwa da dogayen WebSocket hanyoyin haɗin gwiwa suna tafiya daidai?

# Hetzner

## Taswirar Abubuwan Ciki

- [Profile mai aiki](#operating-profile)
- [Zaɓuɓɓukan Faɗawa](#Zaɓuɓɓukan Faɗawa)
- [King Gabatarwar Ƙarfafawa](#sarkin-tsawo-rollout)
- [Model na atomatik] (#autoscaling-model)
- [Sa idanu tare da OpenTelemetry](# sa ido-with-opentelemetry)
- [Imel da DNS](#email-and-dns)
- [Madogararsa](#sources)

## Profile mai aiki

Hetzner ita ce hanyar Infrastructure-as-a-Service kai tsaye. Muna samun sabar da ke tafiyar da API, ma'aunin nauyi, cibiyoyin sadarwa, bangon wuta, IPs masu iyo, da kundin. Wannan ya sa Hetzner ya zama mafi kyawun zaɓi don King lokacin da muke son sarrafa autoscaling kanmu.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  Internet --> LB[Hetzner Load Balancer]
  LB --> FE[Frontend/API Pool]
  LB --> WS[WebSocket Pool]
  LB --> SFU[SFU Pool]
  FE --> DB[(Postgres / Redis)]
  WS --> Redis[(Presence / Session Store)]
  SFU --> Obj[(Object Store)]
  ORC[King Orchestrator] --> HCLOUD[Hetzner Cloud API]
  HCLOUD --> FE
  HCLOUD --> WS
  HCLOUD --> SFU
```

## Zaɓuɓɓukan faɗaɗawa

| Zabin | Amfani da harka | Gyaran atomatik | Shawara |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sabar gajimare guda ɗaya + Docker Rubuta | Mai sauri matukin jirgi | Mai tushe/API | Dev/tsayawa kawai |
| 2-3 sabobin + Hetzner Load Balancer | HA don gaban gaba/API/WS | King ƙungiyar mawaƙa tana daidaita ƙungiyoyin sabar ta hanyar API | Kyakkyawan matsakaicin mataki |
| k3s/Talos/Kubernetes akan Hetzner | Pod HPA, KEDA, kumburin kumburi | Mai ƙarfi, amma muna sarrafa shi | Siffar manufa don ƙwanƙwasa kiran bidiyo |
| Tushen uwar garke + girgije LB | Kafaffen aiki don SFU | Manual ko King mawaƙa | Yana da kyau don iyawa SFU iya aiki |
| Hybrid: Samfuran Codesphere, Hetzner prod | Saurin samfoti + samarwa mai sarrafawa | Preview daban, API-kore | Pragmatic |

## King Fitowar Ƙarfafawa

1. Gina hotunan tushe don `king-api`, `king-ws`, `king-sfu`, da `king-worker`.
2. Sabar uwar garken da tambari: `role=api`, `role=ws`, `role=sfu`, `env=prod`.
3. Yi amfani da hanyar sadarwa mai zaman kansa don API/WS/SFU/DB; Ma'aunin nauyi ne kawai na jama'a.
4. Firewall: kawai 80/443 jama'a, SSH kawai daga admin IP/VPN, tashar jiragen ruwa na ciki kawai akan hanyar sadarwa mai zaman kanta.
5. Mirgine ƙarin King azaman sabis na systemd ko tura Kubernetes.
6. Yi rijista SFU shards tare da ma'aunin iya aiki: CPU, RAM, ɗakuna masu aiki, buga FPS, ƙimar dawowa.
7. Ƙara magudanar ruwa: daina sanya sabbin ɗakuna, bari kiran da ake yi ya ƙare, sannan cire kumburin.

## Model na atomatik

- ** matakin Pod: ** Kubernetes HPA don API/WS/ma'aikaci, KEDA don jerin gwano- ko ma'aikatan da ke jagorantar taron.
- ** Matsayin Node: ** Cluster Autoscaler ko King mawaƙa ta hanyar Hetzner Cloud API.
- **SFU matakin:** sigina na al'ada suna da mahimmanci fiye da CPU: masu wallafe-wallafen aiki, rafukan da ke fita, matsa lamba, hanyoyin dawowa, RTT, da asarar fakiti.
- **Kira aikace-aikacen:** ma'auni azaman tafkin ma'aikaci; ayyuka dole ne su kasance masu ƙarfi.
- ** Kantin sayar da abu: ** abubuwan lodawa, avatars, hotunan bangon waya, da kayan tarihi kada su rayu akan fayafai na gida.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> WarmPool
  WarmPool --> ScaleOut: rooms > threshold or recovery pressure
  ScaleOut --> RegisterNode: hcloud create server
  RegisterNode --> AcceptRooms: health + otel ready
  AcceptRooms --> Drain: low demand or maintenance
  Drain --> DeleteNode: active rooms = 0
  DeleteNode --> WarmPool
```

## Kulawa tare da OpenTelemetry

- Kubernetes: OTel Collector azaman DaemonSet don node/pod logs kuma azaman tura don ma'aunin tari.
- VM/Compose: OTel Collector kowane kumburi azaman sabis na systemd ko akwati.
- Ma'aunin da ake buƙata: `call.join.latency`, `sfu.publisher.count`, `sfu.recovery.routes`, `ws.session.reconnects`, `object_store.upload.duration`, `mail.send.duration`.
- Manufar fitarwa: mai karɓar OTLP na waje na farko; daga baya namu abin lura tari.

## Email da DNS

- Saƙon ma'amala ta hanyar SMTP na waje ko sabis na saƙo mai kwazo.
- Saita SPF, DKIM, da DMRC akan yankin aikawa.
- Rarraba DNS mai tsabta: `app`, `api`, `ws`, `sfu`, `cdn`, `otel`.
- Kada a bijirar da tashoshin jiragen ruwa na bazuwar don SFU; hanya ta hanyar ƙayyadaddun TLS/WebSocket ƙarshen.

- [Madogararsa](#sources)

## Profile mai aiki

Dangane da takaddun jama'a na yanzu, Intares yana kama da abokin ciniki mai gudanarwa / gudanarwar uwar garken tare da keɓaɓɓen sabar, madadin, gudanarwa, da saitin Docker/ na zaɓi na girgije-girgije. Wannan yana da kyau ga ayyukan sadaukar da kai. Samfurin sarrafa kansa na API na sabis na kai kamar Hetzner ko PaaS replica Layer kamar Codesphere ba a rubuce a bainar jama'a isa ya dogara da shi.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  King[King Platform Team] --> Runbook[Runbook + Release Bundle]
  Runbook --> Intares[Intares Managed Ops]
  Intares --> Nodes[Managed Server / Private Cloud]
  Nodes --> Apps[King API / WS / SFU / Worker]
  Apps --> Observability[OTel + Alerts]
  Observability --> King
```

## Zaɓuɓɓukan faɗaɗawa

| Zabin | Amfani da harka | Gyaran atomatik | Hadarin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sarrafawa guda ɗaya | Ƙananan fara samarwa | A tsaye/manual | Babu na'urar sarrafa karu ta kira |
| Gudanar da HA biyu | API/website tare da gazawar | Manual ta runbook | SFU Dole ne a fayyace hanyar zirga-zirga |
| Docker akan sabar da ake gudanarwa | Ayyukan King da za'a iya sakewa | Rubutun/API kawai idan an kunna | Bayyana iyakokin ma'aikata |
| Sabis na girgije mai zaman kansa | Tasiri na musamman abokin ciniki | Mai yiwuwa, amma na kwangila/aiki | Babu zato ba tare da tayin ba |
| Intares + Hetzner/Codesphere hybrid | Gudanar da DB/tsaro + ma'aikatan app na roba a wani wuri | Na waje King mawaƙa | Yi rubutun hanyar sadarwa/ iyakoki GDPR a tsafta |

## King Fitowar Ƙarfafawa

1. Intares yana karɓar nau'in saki mai sigar ko hotuna daga wurin rajistar mu.
2. Muna ba da raka'a systemd ko Shirya / Kubernetes bayyananne don API, WS, SFU, da ma'aikaci.
3. Ba a aika da asirin a cikin dam; an saita su a cikin sirrin Intares/saitin uwar garken.
4. Dole ne a iya samun gwajin lafiya daban ta hanyar saka idanu ta Intares da mawallafin King.
5. Backups: kiyaye DB backups daidaitattun, sigar kantin kayan, kuma kar a adana maɓallan lokacin gudu na gida.
6. Juyawa: kiyaye tsohon hoto / dam da tantance ƙaurawar bayanai tare da dabarar ƙasa a gabani.

## Gaskiyar Autoscaling

- Ba tare da samun damar API na sabis na kai da aka rubuta ba, bai kamata mu tsara Intares a matsayin manufa ta atomatik ba.
- Bidiyo-kiran spikes suna buƙatar aƙalla ra'ayi mai dumi-dumi ko tabbacin lokacin amsawar ma'aikaci.
- SFU Dole ne a tsara sikelin a matsayin tafki mai ƙarfi: ƙayyadaddun shards tare da samarwa na hannu ko na kwangila ta atomatik.
- Idan Intares yana ba da Kubernetes / girgije masu zaman kansu, dokokin Kubernetes sun shafi: HPA / KEDA don nauyin aiki, ƙaddamar da kumburi kawai tare da haɗin kai na mai bada.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant K as King Orchestrator
  participant M as Monitoring
  participant I as Intares Ops
  participant N as Managed Node
  M->>K: capacity pressure
  K->>I: scale request / ticket / API if available
  I->>N: provision or resize
  N-->>K: health ready
  K->>N: assign new rooms
```

## Kulawa tare da OpenTelemetry

- OTel Collector azaman sabis na systemd ko kwantena akan kowane mai masaukin baki.
- Intares saka idanu na iya aiki a layi daya, amma King yana buƙatar nasa bayanan OTLP don ƙayyadaddun ƙira.
- Faɗakar da ɓangarorin biyu: mai aiki don mai watsa shiri / hanyar sadarwa / diski, ƙungiyar King don ma'aunin kira da kurakuran app.

## Email da DNS

- Idan Intares yana aiki da wasiku: fayyace SPF/DKIM/DMRC da billa billa a rubuce.
- Idan ana amfani da SMTP na waje: adana takaddun shaida azaman sirrin da aka sarrafa kuma rubuta yankin aikawa a gefenmu.
- Ƙayyade yankin DNS da ikon mallakar takardar shaidar kafin fitowa.

## Tambayoyi don Intares

- Akwai API don uwar garken / Tacewar zaɓi / LB/DNS / ayyuka na sikelin?
- Ana ba da Docker Shirya, Kubernetes, ko ƙungiyar kade-kaɗe ta girgije?
- Ta yaya ake gudanar da aikin turawa da koma baya?
- Menene SLA ya shafi sikelin gajeriyar sanarwa?
- Shin za mu iya tafiyar da OTel Collector, masu fitar da Prometheus, da namu na kiwon lafiya?
- Ta yaya ake kula da WebSocket da SFU haɗin da aka daɗe a ma'aunin nauyi?

## Sources

- [Intares Managed Hosting] (https://www.intares.de/)
- [Intares Cikakken Gudanar da Gudanarwa / Docker / Cloud mai zaman kansa](https://www.intares.de/full-managed-hosting-green-it/)
- [Kubernetes Autoscaling] (https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/autoscaling/)
- [Mai Buɗewa Mai Tarin Watsa Labarai akan Kubernetes] (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/platforms/kubernetes/getting-started/)

## Profile mai aiki

mitwald yana ba da ɗaukar hoto a cikin mStudio tare da UI, CLI, API, da Terraform. Ana iya farawa kwantena daga rajista, tura su azaman tari, saita su tare da env vars, kundin, da tashar jiragen ruwa, da fallasa ta hanyar yanki/shigarwa. Wannan yana da ƙarfi ga gidan yanar gizo, API, ma'aikaci, da ƙananan ayyuka. Don tsauraran SFU maƙasudin ƙira, har yanzu muna buƙatar gwada ko ana iya sarrafa albarkatun da al'amura ta atomatik.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  Registry[Image Registry] --> MW[mStudio / CLI / Terraform]
  MW --> Stack[Container Stack]
  Stack --> Frontend[Frontend Container]
  Stack --> Api[API Container]
  Stack --> Worker[Worker Container]
  Stack --> Collector[OTel Collector Container]
  Domain[Domain / Ingress] --> Frontend
  Frontend --> Api
  Api --> Worker
```

## Zaɓuɓɓukan faɗaɗawa

| Zabin | Amfani da harka | Gyaran atomatik | Shawara |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mStudio kwantena | Saitin hannu, gwaje-gwaje masu sauri | Manual | Kyakkyawan wurin shiga |
| `mw container run` | Ƙaddamar da rubuce-rubuce | Nassi | Domin runbooks |
| `mw stack deploy` | Ƙirƙirar madaidaitan tari | tushen tari | Yayi kyau ga API/ma'aikaci |
| Mai Bayar da Terraform | Kayan aikin da aka tsara | Mai tsarawa, mai bita | An fi so don mahallin da za a iya haifuwa |
| Sabunta Hoton API | Saki mai jujjuyawa/ cire tag mai canzawa | Mai sarrafa kansa | Yana da amfani ga CI/CD |

## King Fitowar Ƙarfafawa

1. Gina hotunan kwantena don sabis na King kuma tura su zuwa GitHub/GitLab/DockerHub/rejista mai zaman kansa.
2. Ƙayyade tari na mittwald: API, WS, ma'aikaci, mai karɓar zaɓi.
3. Yi amfani da shiga jama'a kawai don gaba/API/WS; haɗa ayyukan ciki ta hanyar sunayen DNS na ciki.
4. Yi amfani da juzu'i kawai don bayanan dagewa. Buffers na lokacin gudu da jitter buffers suna tsayawa a cikin RAM.
5. Sanya tags na hoto mara canzawa: `king-api:1.0.8`, `king-ws:1.0.8`, `king-worker:1.0.8`.
6. Fitar da fitar da `mw container update --image ...` ko Terraform variable `image_tag`.

```bash
mw container run \
  --name king-api \
  --env KING_ENV=production \
  --env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel.example.com \
  -p 8080:8080/tcp \
  registry.example.com/king-api:1.0.8
```

## Kima ta atomatik

- API da ma'aikaci na iya zama cikin akwati da kyau.
- Don bidiyo SFU, gwada haɗin kai na dogon lokaci, ajiyar CPU, halayen tashar jiragen ruwa/shigarwa, da sarrafa misali a kwance.
- Ba tare da an rubuta siffa ta atomatik na asali ba, shirya mitwald azaman maƙasudin kwantena da aka sarrafa tare da sarrafa sikeli ta hanyar API/Teraform, ba azaman cikakken atomatik SFU autoscaler.
- Aikace-aikacen kira na iya gudana cikin kwantena ma'aikata da yawa idan jerin gwano/makulle suna zaune a wajen dandalin kwantena.

## Kulawa tare da OpenTelemetry

- Fitar da OTel kai tsaye daga kowane akwati zuwa mai tarawa na waje.
- Madadin haka, gudanar da mai tarawa a matsayin kwandonsa a cikin tari idan isarwar ciki ta tabbata.
- Ci gaba da gani a cikin mStudio, amma kar a yi amfani da su azaman tushen ganowa kaɗai.

## Email da DNS

- Aika saƙo ta hanyar waje na SMTP/mai ba da ma'amala ko wasiƙar mittwald kawai bayan duba isarwa.
- Sanya SPF/DKIM/DMRC don yankin aikawa.
- Taswirar wuraren jama'a a cikin mStudio zuwa kwantena/shiga: `app`, `api`, `ws`, na zaɓi `cdn`.
